🚀 How to Hand Claude a Long Task and Walk Away

Claude Opus 5.5 carries long, multipart work further than Opus 5, but it can still stop at a progress report. Here is how to write the brief, set up a checklist, name the stops you don't want, decide what needs your approval, and review the result when you return.

Read more: https://zyvop.com/how-to-hand-claude-a-long-task-and-walk-away-f6ita?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=crosspost
